name: First State DME
old_description: At First State DME, we offer an extensive line of medical equipment to fit almost anyones needs.  We service all of Delaware and surrounding areas and offer free delivery on certain items and quantities!  Browse what we have to offer online or come in to check out our show room.  We supply to the public and also accept certain insurance policies.
about:
First State DME operates from a showroom and service center at 4115 North Dupont Highway in Dover, Delaware. The company provides durable medical equipment and related services throughout the state and in surrounding areas.

The business sells and rents a broad range of home medical equipment, including mobility aids, respiratory devices, and daily living aids. It also supplies orthotic bracing solutions, inserts, and therapeutic shoes. In addition to sales and rentals, First State DME offers repair and technical services performed by qualified technicians, prosthetic and orthotic services at its Dover location and via mobile calls across Delaware, and product delivery with free shipping on qualifying orders. Financing options are available for customers.

First State DME serves individual patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers across Delaware. It accepts various insurance policies and works with workers' compensation claims. The company’s customer base includes anyone needing durable medical equipment for home use, as well as those requiring prosthetic or orthotic fittings.

The company emphasizes customer service as its distinguishing feature, stating that its friendly staff guarantees satisfaction and that it provides high-quality medical equipment at competitive prices.
